author: steferz
body: Plumeria Cafe in Laguna Niguel, only open until 2:00pm daily. The Kahlua Pork Chilaquiles are incredible. The Blueberry Ricotta Pancakes, amazing! Just want to point out that I hate blueberries and hubby hates ricotta and we both CRAVE these 🥞

author: Hefty_Procedure_8415
body: Love this place! Everything I’ve tried on the menu so far has been solid. Miss the times being able to enjoy breakfast there with gramps.
